title: Determination vs determinism - A discussion
summary: Answering a subscriber who argued that potential and even discipline are partly genetic, he concedes that genetics matter for champions. He insists that discipline is built, not inherited, and that potential is only revealed by work. Believing in genetic limits creates finish lines in your mind that make you slow down or stop, whereas natural bodybuilding should be a marathon with no finish line.
claims: With determination, mental strength and effort you can accomplish almost anything; many limitations are created in people's minds
He has no sympathy for the black pill and those who give up, only pity, but tries to get them back on their feet
Discipline and work ethic are not genetic traits; they can be developed
A potential that is never revealed by work never existed; you cannot know your potential without training
He thought he had bad lat genetics and high insertions, but he simply did not know how to train them
World-record holders combine elite genetics, hard work and ideal environment; one trait at an extreme can trump the others, but godlike talent is very rare
Giving up on anything you are not gifted at means never investing time in anything and living in despair
He has been destroyed at judo, crushed at swimming meets and outclassed at basketball, and kept going anyway
Champions do not all share one profile: Jordan was not a 7-foot freak, and the hardest hitter on his football team was about 5'7 and 150 lb
Fighting spirit is not genetic; it can be developed
He does not aim to be a champion; he wants to push his body to its limits even if they are mediocre, and will only stop when they close his coffin
Do not give yourself goals with deadlines; have an ideal and work toward it, knowing it will move further away once you get there
Insane talent without hard work can surpass hard work and drugs; a talentless person can be as good as they can be but never the best, and some take grams of drugs and go nowhere
Genetic differences in lactic acid or pain sensitivity change performance, but enduring pain is surmountable by spirit and does not make discipline genetic
Someone who needs insane discipline just to get average results builds a discipline that carries over to studies and work
Not everything in life hinges on physical ability or looks; being ugly does not stop you from making yourself the best version of you
Willpower cannot be compared between people; only you know if you truly pushed, and you cannot lie to yourself at night
Once willpower is maxed out it becomes discipline: doing it whether it rains, it is minus 20 degrees or you are in pain; you transcend motivation
Champions with poor genetics were not born disciplined; their discipline was a psychological response to their bad hand
Arnold did not have the best bodybuilding genetics (wide waist, underdeveloped legs) and started PEDs at 14; he made himself through discipline and sacrifice
Perfect pitch can be trained; he knew someone who developed it through hard work
Talent is double-edged: gifted people often quit at the first real roadblock because they never learned to work
At 18 his arms were the size of his wrists; if he had decided he had no potential it would have been a self-fulfilling prophecy
Belief in genetic limits creates mental roadblocks, which is why natural standards are so low; French fitness YouTube is even worse, with mostly unimpressive physiques
Do not just do your best; kill it, because your capacity to push grows as you grow
Do not think about limits or a finish line: cross it and you lose motivation, see it coming and you slow down
Natural bodybuilding and the pursuit of discipline is a marathon without a finish line
